data.name: Lanette
data.gender_notes: Lanette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Lanatus' meaning 'covered in wool', or from the Greek 'Lanthaneo' meaning 'to hide'. The name Lanette may have originated as a nickname for a woman with fair complexion or a bright disposition. The name Lanette carries the meaning “Light, bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lanette usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of light and brightness, guiding and illuminating the way.
data.etymology: Lanette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lanette total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

In the Arthurian legend, Lancelot is one of King Arthur's most trusted knights and a key figure in the story of the Holy Grail. The name Lanette is also connected to the name Lancel, which is one of the names of Lancelot. The name Lanette is often associated with qualities such as chivalry, honor, and loyalty.
